processBand.title: From Concept to Completion, We Are With You
processBand.description: As an integrated supplier, we bring design, manufacturing, installation, and after-sales together — one-stop coordination with clear follow-through.

survey.title: Needs Assessment
survey.desc: We review your site, training objectives, team size, and budget to define clear project goals.

design.title: Solution Design
design.desc: Engineers and fire experts co-design layouts, props, and structures for realism and compliance.

manufacture.title: Manufacturing
manufacture.desc: Factory-built with quality control at every step for long-lasting components.

install.title: On-Site Installation
install.desc: Professional turnkey installation from foundations through final handover.

training.title: Training & Delivery
training.desc: User training and acceptance so your team can operate effectively from day one.

service.title: After-Sales Support
service.desc: Long-term maintenance, parts supply, and compliance checks to protect your investment.
